name: Utah House Bill 452 — Artificial Intelligence Amendments (Mental Health Chatbots, Utah Code Title 13, Chapter 72a)
description: Utah statute regulating mental health chatbots that use AI to provide therapeutic or mental health communications: requires clear pre-interaction and recurring disclosure that the chatbot is an AI and not a human therapist, restricts the sale or sharing of individually identifiable health inputs and targeted advertising inside chatbot conversations, and requires documentation of foundation models and crisis guardrails.
